caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork slices. Topped with sesame seeds, chopped green onions, and dark pickled ginger, it sits in a patterned bowl against a warm pink background under soft, even lighting.

segments_info.text: The surface is a smooth, solid pinkish-red with subtle gradient shading and faint texture variations.
Chashu pork: tender, thinly sliced, with glossy surface and visible marbling, resting atop green onions and sesame seeds.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy, golden-brown, and glossy, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
The bowl is white ceramic with a colorful geometric pattern and a raised, decorated rim.
